audit.label: Audit
audit.headline: Systems Audit Manager | IT & Integrated Assurance | CISA
audit.summary:
Systems Audit Manager at Bank of Kigali with over six years in IT and integrated finance/IT audit. Promoted from Auditor (2020) to Senior (2021) to Manager (2024). Work covers core banking, payments, and digital channels for a bank serving more than 500,000 customers.

Main strengths are risk-based systems audits, ITGC and application controls, data validation on major core banking migrations (Delta to T24; NuoDB to Oracle), and support to finance on reconciliations and revenue issues. CISA and CISM certified. Comfortable with ISO/IEC 27001, SWIFT CSP, and PCI-DSS environments.

Also introduce practical automation and data analysis into audit work so reviews are faster and findings are clearer for management.

security.label: Security
security.headline: Information Security & Cyber Assurance | CISA · CISM · CEH
security.summary:
Information security and cyber assurance professional with over six years in banking. As Systems Audit Manager at Bank of Kigali, I lead cyber and IT audits on core banking, payments, and digital platforms, using ISO/IEC 27001, SWIFT CSP, and PCI-DSS as reference points.

Background includes ethical hacking (CEH), secure application work, SIEM-based anomaly detection research at CMU Africa, and malware analysis. Day-to-day work is more GRC and assurance: control assessments, cloud reviews, incident response readiness, and disaster recovery checks.

Hold CISA, CISM, CEH, and ISO 27001 Lead Auditor. Aim is simple: find what is weak, explain the risk clearly, and push for fixes that stick.

risk.label: Risk
risk.headline: IT & Operational Risk | Controls and Resilience
risk.summary:
Risk and controls professional with over six years working across finance and technology at Bank of Kigali. Experience sits mainly in independent assurance, with close work on systems risk, third-party and vendor exposure, business continuity (ISO 22301), and control issues that affect financial integrity.

Received the 2024 Bank of Kigali Risk Management Award for leading data validation on the T24 R20 NuoDB-to-Oracle migration, on systems used by more than 500,000 customers. Regularly work with finance on reconciliation problems, revenue leakage, and old system issues, using data analysis to show impact.

CISA, CISM, and Lead Auditor for ISO 27001 and ISO 22301. Prefer recommendations that are risk-ranked and usable by management, not long lists of findings with no priority.

academic.label: Academic
academic.headline: Cybersecurity Practitioner | MS IT, CMU Africa · CISA · CISM · CEH
academic.summary:
MS in Information Technology from Carnegie Mellon University Africa, with over six years in cyber, IT, and systems assurance in banking. Previously a Graduate Teaching Assistant at CMU Africa for cybersecurity and ethical hacking labs.

Industry work covers ISO 27001, SWIFT CSP, core banking controls, secure development practices, and risk management at Bank of Kigali. Research projects at CMU focused on AI for threat and anomaly detection, and machine learning for malware behaviour analysis. Have also built production web and mobile applications (Django, Flutter) part-time.

Interested in teaching that mixes standards and theory with how controls and security decisions work in real institutions, especially for a Bachelor of Cybersecurity programme.
